chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Drinking water at night while standing causes yellow water.

key_terms.اَلْمَاءَ اَلْأَصْفَرَ: yellow water; a yellow bodily ailment

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about drinking water at night while standing?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys an etiquette related to drinking water, specifically discouraging drinking at night while standing. It presents this manner of drinking as leading to a harmful bodily condition described as yellow water.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4244 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"Drinking water while standing at night causes yellow water (jaundice)."
